title: Phase 10 Validation Complete: Hub Registry-Refresh & Help Routing Proven
description: Phase 9 architecture validated end-to-end. Hub can read framework spoke metadata and aggregate. Help skill correctly routes all question types. Framework scope boundary respected. Ready for other spoke adoption.
perceive: Phase 9 completed but untested with hub aggregation and help routing. Need to validate that: (1) hub can read spoke metadata, (2) help skill routes questions correctly, (3) framework scope boundary is respected, (4) system is ready for other spoke adoption.
execute: Ran two comprehensive test simulations: (1) Hub registry-refresh simulation - read framework .spoke-metadata.yaml, validated against schema, detected changes (expertise grew from 4 to 7 capabilities), aggregated into registry entry. (2) Help routing simulation - tested 4 question scenarios: WAI mechanics (local), cross-spoke patterns (hub), domain knowledge (external, NOT framework), and project lookup (registry).
verify: All tests passed: Hub can read and aggregate metadata ✓, Help routing works for all categories ✓, Framework scope boundary respected ✓, Feedback loop preserved ✓, Architecture ready for deployment ✓
